name: media
description: Voice-memo lookup behavior over the live archive: verbatim transcript requests resolve deterministically; summary requests feed the full stored transcript to the model.

cases.question: Send me the transcript of my latest voice memo.
cases.notes: Transcript requests must return the stored transcript verbatim via the direct path, not evidence-QA excerpts.

cases.question: Summarize the 21 minute voice memo.
cases.notes: Duration hints select the memo; the model summarizes the full transcript, not a retrieval excerpt.

cases.question: Transcribe the voice memo from Zebediah.
cases.notes: A sender with no transcribed memos must get an honest empty result, not a hallucinated transcript.
